prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: high-fidelity visual concept board for an existing Persian RTL ENT surgeon website. Current brand: deep navy #14273d, warm cream #fcfaf7, restrained gold #e5bc74. Clean editorial healthcare design, generous whitespace, elegant accurate Persian typography. Real doctor name verbatim "دکتر فرزاد زمانی"; specialty "متخصص گوش، حلق و بینی"; CTA verbatim "رزرو نوبت". Other copy must be neutral and concise. Never invent credentials, number of surgeries, testimonials, stars, success percentages, medical advice, patient results or patient photos. No awards/badges, no web design watermark, no copied third-party brand. Concept for review, not deployment. Input image 1 is a REFERENCE ONLY of the real doctor: preserve his exact face, glasses, suit and identity when placing the same portrait; don't alter or beautify his face. Input image 2 is the existing wordmark reference: preserve its shape and spelling. Make a large landscape design board with desktop homepage hero on the left and a mobile version on the right, clean cream board margin, small board label "هیرو · سرمه‌ای". Desktop RTL: restrained slim navy navbar, doctor wordmark at upper right, few nav links middle, gold booking CTA left. In hero, main copy on right, doctor portrait on left; portrait anchored without adding glow or extra decorative rings. Broad dark navy flat background, oversized gold doctor name, white specialty, one short neutral line "آشنایی با خدمات و مسیر مراجعه", two buttons "رزرو نوبت" and "مشاهده خدمات". Small factual row "اراک · مراجعه با هماهنگی". Lower edge has a slim cream navigation band for "خدمات" / "نمونه‌کارها" / "اطلاعات مطب". Mobile: readable title and specialty before portrait, compact CTA above fold and three-button contact/navigation/booking bar below content. Thoughtful spacing, realistic screenshot-like geometry, no browser chrome.
